# ProfileBizz — India's Business Story Platform

ProfileBizz is India's premier editorial platform covering the new economy through in-depth founder profiles, brand histories, industry analyses, city-level business directories, success stories, and social impact narratives. All content focuses on Indian entrepreneurs, MSMEs, and businesses.

## About

ProfileBizz publishes authoritative long-form content about India's business ecosystem — from first-generation founders in Tier-2 cities to unicorn builders and legacy conglomerates. Content includes verified revenue figures, milestone timelines, founding stories, and strategic analyses.

## Key Content Sections

### Founder Profiles (/founder/)
In-depth biographical profiles of Indian founders and entrepreneurs. Each profile includes founding story, revenue milestones, team size, business model, and key decisions. Notable profiles:
- /founder/nithin-kamath — Nithin Kamath, Co-Founder & CEO of Zerodha (India's largest stockbroker)
- /founder/rajesh-kumar-vedas — Rajesh Kumar Vedas, Founder of Vedas Agro Industries

### Brand Stories (/brand/)
Detailed histories of iconic Indian brands covering origin, growth, key turning points, and market position.
- /brand/amul — Amul (dairy cooperative, founded 1946)
- /brand/tata — Tata Group (conglomerate, founded 1868)
- /brand/parle — Parle (FMCG / biscuits, founded 1929)
- /brand/haldiram — Haldiram's (food & snacks, founded 1937)
- /brand/mahindra — Mahindra Group (auto & conglomerate, founded 1945)
- /brand/asian-paints — Asian Paints (paints & décor, founded 1942)
- /brand/vedas-agro — Vedas Agro Industries (agri-processing, founded 2011)

### Industry Deep-Dives (/industry/)
Sector-level analyses of India's major industries with market size, key players, and growth trends.
- /industry/steel — Steel industry (₹2.5L Cr market)
- /industry/agriculture — Agriculture (₹20L Cr, foundation of Bharat economy)
- /industry/fmcg — FMCG / Consumer goods (₹5.8L Cr)
- /industry/solar — Solar energy / clean tech (₹1.8L Cr)
- /industry/ev — Electric vehicles (₹50,000 Cr)
- /industry/real-estate — Real estate / infrastructure (₹13L Cr)
- /industry/healthcare — Healthcare / life sciences (₹8.6L Cr)
- /industry/it — IT & technology / digital economy (₹10.4L Cr)
- /industry/scrap — Scrap / circular economy (₹1.2L Cr)
- /industry/biofuel — Biofuel / green energy (₹35,000 Cr)

### City Business Directories (/local/)
City-level profiles covering local business ecosystems, major industries, and prominent entrepreneurs.
- /local/mumbai — Mumbai (financial capital, 15L+ businesses)
- /local/delhi — Delhi NCR (business capital, 12L+ businesses)
- /local/ahmedabad — Ahmedabad (textile & trade capital, 4.2L+ businesses)
- /local/surat — Surat (diamond & textile city, 3.5L+ businesses)
- /local/vadodara — Vadodara (chemical & pharma belt, 2.1L+ businesses)
- /local/rajkot — Rajkot (engineering hub, 1.8L+ businesses)

### Success Stories (/success/)
Category-based narratives of Indian business success across segments.
- /success/business-growth — Scale & expansion stories
- /success/startup-success — Zero-to-one startup journeys
- /success/export-success — Made-in-India global success
- /success/women-success — Women entrepreneur trailblazers
- /success/youth-success — Gen Z & millennial founders
- /success/village-success — Bharat Rising — rural business stories

### Social Impact (/impact/)
Stories of Indian organisations driving social and environmental change.
- /impact/ngo — NGO and community champion profiles
- /impact/education — Education equity initiatives
- /impact/healthcare — Health equity stories
- /impact/environment — Environmental sustainability
- /impact/village-development — Rural development
- /impact/csr — Corporate social responsibility

### Business News Categories (/news/)
Category hubs for ongoing business news coverage.
- /news/funding — Investment rounds and fundraising
- /news/expansion — Growth and new market entry
- /news/acquisitions — Mergers, acquisitions, and deals
- /news/new-products — Product launches and innovations
- /news/factory-launch — Manufacturing and industrial launches
- /news/govt-schemes — Government policy and schemes for business
- /news/awards — Business recognition and rankings

### Special Sections
- /social-hero — Social Hero Profiles (changemakers and community leaders)
- /women-story — Women in Business spotlight
